top_issues: Legend overload under balance: four colored dots with tiny text ('On-chain', 'Reserve', 'Secured', 'At risk') compress critical state into unreadable metadata.
Obscure scale debug string '1 px = $10 · auto · 3 empty hidden' displayed directly above the empty state message, leaking internal mental models to casual users.
Primary action button hierarchy is weak: Pay is high-contrast purple while Receive and Swap are dim dark grey cards, confusing basic funding onboarding.
fixes: Replace four dot-labels with a segmented tactile breakdown bar and tappable chips showing exact category balances.
Hide the '1 px = $10' scale indicator behind settings or show only when non-zero balance bars are actively rendered.
Give Receive an equal primary or secondary visual affordance so empty-balance users immediately know how to deposit.

top_issues: The Accounts card shows '0.00 even' and a stray vertical pipe separator '|' with empty send/receive limits, failing to communicate account readiness.
Open account button lives inside an existing 'H1 hub' card that is already listed, blurring whether an account is open, pending, or inactive.
Recent activity card shows 'Account opened · created' without timestamp, network, or confirmation status.
fixes: Replace the solitary '|' delimiter with an explicit bilateral capacity meter bar with defined min/max endpoints.
Clarify account card state: badge as 'Connected' or replace '+ Open account' with '+ Add lane / deposit'.
Add relative timestamp and status icon to the Recent activity preview card.

top_issues: QR code dominates viewport while 'No inbound room yet' warning appears below fold, letting users show a QR code that will fail to receive.
Secondary inputs ('Amount · optional', 'Prepare incoming account') look identical in card weight, obscuring the primary action.
Currency selector badge 'USDC' lacks clear visual affordance for changing destination asset.
fixes: Dim or place a warning banner directly over the QR code when inbound capacity is 0.00.
Move the 'No inbound room' alert banner above the QR code or disable QR generation until inbound room exists.
Add chevron and border highlight to the USDC currency pill.

top_issues: Raw 66-character hex Entity ID is displayed without chunking or one-tap copy button inside its card.
Duplicate share buttons ('Copy invoice', 'Copy link', 'Copy xln:// app link') confuse invoice formats versus deep links.
Warning 'No inbound room yet. Extend a credit line to a hub...' uses technical jargon without explaining financial counterparty risk.
fixes: Format Entity ID as truncated monospace chunks with an explicit copy/scan icon button.
Consolidate sharing to one primary 'Copy payment request' button with a secondary format picker.
Explain 'Extend credit line' in plain terms: 'Allow hub to route up to $X payments to you'.

top_issues: You pay shows '100 USDC' but You receive shows '0.00 WETH' while the Swap button is enabled/colored, giving zero price estimate.
Error message 'Prepare incoming capacity before swapping' is rendered in small red text floating unanchored between cards and CTA.
Testnet badge inside asset selector is crowded against dropdown arrow.
fixes: Compute and display live estimated output amount based on orderbook top-of-book instead of static 0.00.
Disable Swap CTA button and convert red text into an explicit button state: 'Increase WETH inbound capacity'.
Separate network tag into a distinct row or header chip.

top_issues: Orderbook depth bars use fixed yellow and green bars that lack visible scale reference relative to total book liquidity.
Spread indicator is cramped between bid/ask ladders with low visual contrast.
Instruction 'Tap a level to fill the ticket at that price. 1 tick = 1/10,000 USDC' is dense fine print.
fixes: Add subtle cumulative depth background shading behind size numbers.
Give the spread line an explicit badge container with mid-market reference price.
Shorten book caption to 'Tap price to set limit'.

top_issues: Action grid has 4 buttons with inconsistent verbs ('Pay', 'Extend credit', 'Swap', 'Manage'), mixing routine actions with credit ops.
Empty lanes link 'Show 3 empty lanes · USDC, WETH, USDT' looks like broken inline text rather than an expandable control.
Core metric cards are missing: no clear display of settled balance, credit limit, or counterparty collateral on this screen.
fixes: Display actual bilateral numbers: Your balance, Hub collateral, Unsecured credit.
Transform 'Show 3 empty lanes' into a structured list or card showing inactive currency lanes with an 'Enable' toggle.
Standardize action buttons into a cohesive 3-button primary row with secondary ops in Manage.

top_issues: Vast empty vertical void with a single historical item 'Account opened with H1'.
Filter pills ('All', 'Payments', 'Swaps', 'Settlement', 'Accou...') truncate on standard mobile width.
List row lacks amount, counterparty address snippet, or settlement timestamp.
fixes: Make filter pill container smoothly horizontally scrollable with faded edge mask, avoiding cut-off text.
Add timestamp and status pill to activity row items.
Display helpful empty state illustration/hint under the single entry for new users.

top_issues: Receipt modal lacks an export/share button or cryptographic proof hash download for verification.
Time shows '05:00:59' without date, timezone, or block/epoch anchor.
Counterparty H1 address is truncated to '0x23d8a3...21b7' with no copy icon.
fixes: Add 'Share Receipt' and 'Export Evidence' buttons at the bottom of the modal.
Include full ISO date and frame hash in addition to frame number.
Make counterparty row tappable with inline copy feedback.

top_issues: 'Dollars per pixel' slider occupies top priority in Settings, treating an obscure UI visual scale as the primary user configuration.
Toggles for 'On-chain wallet', 'Reserve', 'Accounts' explain architecture rather than clear user functionality.
'Layout on wide screens' toggle appears on a mobile viewport where it is largely irrelevant.
fixes: Move 'Scale' under an 'Advanced / Visual' section; place Security & Network at the top.
Rephrase toggles from technical storage categories to clear visibility toggles (e.g. 'Show on-chain balances').
Hide wide-screen desktop layout toggle on mobile clients.

top_issues: 'AT THIS SCALE' diagnostic card shows raw pixel calculations ('$10,000 = 1,000 px', '$100,000 = 10,000 px') that feel like an internal developer test harness.
Red 'Forget vault' button sits immediately beside 'Reveal recovery phrase' and 'Lock' with minimal destructive safety hierarchy.
Runtime ID hex is displayed in raw full string, overwhelming visual flow.
fixes: Remove pixel calibration debug chart from consumer production build or nest in Dev Tools.
Separate 'Forget vault' into an isolated danger zone section requiring confirmed phrase export.
Truncate Runtime ID with one-tap copy button.

top_issues: Two identical 3-card grids for 'FROM' and 'TO' ('Wallet', 'Reserve', 'Account') create visual noise and high cognitive load.
Input amount '250' with error 'Amount exceeds what is available here' in plain text while 'Sign & send' is still active/colored.
Token selector 'USDC' sits unanchored in the top app bar rather than inside the transfer card.
fixes: Replace duplicate 3-box grids with an interactive source/destination toggle sheet or segmented pill selector.
Anchor token selector directly adjacent to the Amount input field.
Properly disable 'Sign & send' CTA button when balance validation fails.

top_issues: 'Recipient entity · leave empty for yourself' input creates confusion about whether this is a transfer to oneself or a payment.
'Add to batch' button sits next to 'Sign & send' without explaining what batching accomplishes on mobile.
'WHAT HAPPENS' card uses small low-contrast body text to explain complex settlement mechanisms.
fixes: Separate internal rebalancing (self) from external entity transfers into distinct views.
Hide 'Add to batch' behind advanced flow or long-press; reserve primary bar for direct execution.
Increase font contrast and add step icons inside the 'WHAT HAPPENS' explainer card.

top_issues: 2x2 plus single orphan grid for navigation cards ('Sovereignty', 'Move', 'Assets', 'Lending', 'Ownership') has uneven layout cadence.
Hub account entry at bottom shows '3 lanes · 2 frames · open' with no balance or financial health indicator.
'Needs attention: Nothing waiting on you' occupies valuable vertical space with negative value.
fixes: Reorganize navigation into a consistent vertical list with descriptive subtitles and status indicators.
Show total active balance and exposure inside each Hub row in Accounts.
Collapse 'Needs attention' into a badge counter only when action is actually required.

top_issues: 'Depository may pull 0.00' subtitle under each asset is legally precise but opaque to normal users.
Hex contract addresses for Signer and Depository clutter the top card without clear copy/explorer actions.
'Move into reserve' button is placed inside the token list rather than as a primary page action.
fixes: Replace 'Depository may pull' with simple 'Approved for reserve: $0.00' or an approval toggle.
Add block explorer links and copy buttons to Depository and Signer addresses.
Pin 'Move into reserve' as a floating bottom CTA or top action bar button.

top_issues: Faucets section at bottom is cut off by the navigation bar with unreadable text.
Slider card 'Prepare to receive' shows 'Collateral unavailable' but provides no clear path forward.
Three stacked full-width buttons ('Receive USDC from H1', 'USDC to my on-chain wallet', 'Gas (ETH)...', 'USDC straight into my reserve') overwhelm the user with ambiguous deposit paths.
fixes: Fix bottom padding so Faucets content clears the bottom navigation bar.
Group on-chain funding into a unified 'Deposit / Faucet' modal.
Explain why collateral is unavailable and offer automated hub matching.

top_issues: Segmented toggle 'Lend / Borrow' sits awkwardly isolated between token selection and amount input.
Term picker buttons ('1 hour', '1 day', '1 month') lack rate comparison or estimated yield preview.
Hub picker card 'H1 3 lanes' does not display hub credit rating or historical default rate.
fixes: Move 'Lend / Borrow' toggle to the top navigation header.
Show projected APY and return calculation beneath the term picker buttons.
Add counterparty reputation and pool size metadata to the Hub selector.

top_issues: CTA 'Offer to the pool' button is enabled despite lending amount being 0.00.
H1 Pool statistics card shows all zeroes ('Available 0.00', 'Borrowed 0.00', 'Active principal 0.00') without context on whether the pool is active.
Interest rate input uses 'basis points' (100 = 1.00%), which is developer jargon unfamiliar to mainstream users.
fixes: Disable CTA button when input amount is zero or exceeds wallet balance.
Display standard percentage inputs with a toggle for basis points.
Add pool health status indicator and total liquidity depth chart.

top_issues: Term 'Kind: Lazy (hash of its board)' uses internal engineering terminology without intuitive legal/operational meaning.
Card explains 'Register it on the EntityProvider to issue shares or change owners' but provides no registration action button.
'TAKE CONTROL OF ANOTHER ENTITY' header sounds adversarial rather than administrative.
fixes: Replace 'Lazy' with 'Unregistered / Sovereign Key' and add a tooltip.
Add a primary 'Register Entity on-chain' button inside the Board card.
Rename 'Take control of another entity' to 'Import or claim entity role'.

top_issues: The legend text explaining Green vs Violet is long and dense, requiring users to read a multi-sentence paragraph to interpret risk.
Four balance items under '$0.00 Enforceable right now' lack horizontal visual bar indicators despite the wallet's proportional scale philosophy.
Signer and Entity addresses are truncated without instant copy or QR display.
fixes: Represent Green and Violet balances with a segmented bar directly under the headline balance.
Add copy icons and quick verification links next to Signer and Entity hashes.
Condense the risk explainer into an interactive breakdown: 'Guaranteed on-chain' vs 'Counterparty credit'.

top_issues: 'Can dispute without asking: 1 of 1' is powerful but cryptic regarding how a dispute is actually triggered.
'Save evidence bundle' button saves state locally but does not indicate file format, size, or verification checksum.
Per-counterparty row lists 'they answer in 1 d, you in 1 d' in tiny inline text that obscures the challenge window terms.
fixes: Add an explicit 'Test Dispute / Challenge' dry-run action alongside evidence saving.
Show evidence bundle metadata (e.g. 'JSON bundle · 2 signed frames · SHA-256 verified').
Format dispute challenge windows into structured badges (e.g., 'Challenge window: 24h').

overall.verdict: The mobile dark UI achieves exceptional cryptographic rigor and consistent visual polish, creating high confidence for protocol specialists. However, it exposes raw engine primitives, empty capacity dead-ends, and unassisted credit concepts that severely block mainstream onboarding and rapid mobile transactions.
priority_fixes: Fix the zero inbound capacity roadblock on Receive and Swap screens with an automated one-tap channel/credit setup flow.
Replace developer-centric debug elements ('1 px = $10', pixel scale tables, 'Lazy' entity) with intuitive financial terms and clean abstractions.
Add explicit receipt export, proof hash sharing, and challenge-window triggers to turn theoretical sovereignty into actionable verification.
Streamline the Move and Onboarding flows by unifying internal reserve rebalancing and external transfers into a guided wizard.
Provide real-time price estimation and output calculation on Swap instead of showing 0.00 for valid inputs.

personas.name: Maya
personas.verdict: I'm terrified to touch anything because it's asking me about hubs, testnets, reserves, and inbound capacity when I just want to receive $20.
blockers: 04-receive.png shows 'No inbound room yet' with no simple 'Deposit with card/on-chain' button; she cannot receive money without configuring a credit line to a hub.

personas.name: Tomasz
personas.verdict: I immediately understand the bilateral channel mechanics, credit limits, and off-chain signed frames, but the channel status indicators need cleaner visual bars.
blockers: 01-home.png and 06-account.png use a bare vertical separator '|' instead of a dual-sided capacity bar showing local vs remote balance.

personas.name: Anya
personas.verdict: The orderbook and tick sizing are great, but the swap interface refused to calculate my expected fill and threw an inbound capacity error.
blockers: 05-swap.png displays '0.00 WETH' receive amount for 100 USDC input and blocks execution with 'Prepare incoming capacity before swapping'.

personas.name: Ravi
personas.verdict: The sovereignty breakdown and Depository reserve separation are exactly what our board needs, but I cannot export a cryptographic report from the receipts.
blockers: 08-activity-detail.png lacks an 'Export Proof Bundle' or signed transaction receipt link for accounting audits.

personas.name: Sofia
personas.verdict: I can copy an invoice link, but my client cannot pay me because the screen warns there is no inbound room and offers no clear link to share with a non-crypto client.
blockers: 04-receive-bottom.png generates an invoice that will fail without pre-existing hub credit, and lacks PDF/image receipt generation on 08-activity-detail.png.

personas.name: Kenji
personas.verdict: Outstanding: co-signed frame counts, unilateral dispute readiness, and local evidence bundle downloads are front and center.
blockers: 15-sovereignty-bottom.png allows downloading the bundle but does not provide an on-screen dispute simulator or direct Depository contract submission button.

personas.name: Lena
personas.verdict: There is no fast QR scanner on home, paying requires multiple setup steps, and I cannot complete a checkout with one hand.
blockers: 01-home.png has no top-level camera/scan QR shortcut; Pay flow requires pre-funded accounts and hub selection.

personas.name: Marcus
personas.verdict: Clear visibility into signed frames, Depository escrow, and pool lending rates, though counterparty risk needs deeper historical telemetry.
blockers: 13-lend.png and 06-account.png do not show real-time counterparty utilization rates, default risk metrics, or multi-lane settlement history.

personas.name: Fatima
personas.verdict: I see cross-network tabs on the swap screen, but fee breakdowns and route transparency are completely missing.
blockers: 05-swap.png has 'Across networks' disabled or unconfigured, and 10-move.png gives no cross-chain bridge fee or time estimates.

personas.name: Dmitri
personas.verdict: In three minutes I grasped the core thesis: money is either green (enforceable on-chain) or violet (counterparty credit), with bilateral signed frames keeping it pure.
blockers: 09-settings-bottom.png and 01-home.png dilute the institutional thesis with amateurish pixel-scale debug widgets.
